lineage: fidelity probe p06_title_overflow, 2026-09-24 (promoted by WP-G G-2, 2026-09-25)
notes: Findings F5 (weights) and F4 (a locked title line that wraps again), and 16-WPG 2's evidence: five rows at
font-weight 300-700 in the minor font, a 700 title on the Calibri-Light major, UA-bold <h4> card headings in
the major font, a long hyphenated title, and overflow:hidden cards.
Two changes from the probe. Card 2 ('Overflows (clipped in HTML)') gained two sentences. In the master's
Calibri the probe's copy fit (4 lines ending at y 330 of the card's 370), so the case exercised nothing; now
its seventh line falls below the card's padding box and the as-seen package's clip rule (F) keeps the six
visible lines and reports the hidden one - the 'text is clipped' error the case exists for. Card 3
('Tight fit', the probe's 'copy that reaches the very bottom edge of the card') ended 58 px above its
clip edge, so it tested nothing (G-2 review m2); its last paragraph now has 4 lines, and the last line box
ends at y 366.5 (glyph box 364.9), 3.5 px inside the card's padding box (370: overflow:hidden clips at
the padding edge, not at the 14 px padding's inner edge, 356). It holds both boundaries: no false 'text
is clipped' and no 'text-overflow' for a paragraph that ends inside its clip, and no fit issue in the
export (test_torture.test_weights_tight_card_reaches_its_clip_edge_unreported).
Emitted faces (G-1's emitted_face, 16-WPG 2.3), read from the file on 2026-09-25: the title and the h4s
+mj-lt b=1 (Calibri Light has no Bold member, so b=1 asks for emboldening - G-1's rule (b); on test-16x9 the
theme part names Calibri as major, so PowerPoint and PptxRender draw Calibri Bold, ~3 % wider and heavier
than the browser's Calibri Light, which Edge emboldens synthetically at 700 with its advances unchanged
(measured 2026-09-25, 30 px, 'Why balance-sheet banks are losing share': ink 2,180 at 300 and 400, 3,369
at 700, 3,901 for Calibri Bold; width 502.8 px at every Calibri Light weight, 520.2 px for Calibri Bold;
test_emit.test_the_browser_emboldens_calibri_light_at_700 holds it). So b=1 is what the browser drew, and
writing b=0 there would export every bold heading on a Calibri-Light major as Light - the masters'
mismatch, which the 860 px title box absorbs; bench.py --renderer both, 2026-09-25: the PowerPoint panel
shows the bold title, the 300 row light, 400 and 500 alike, 600 and 700 bold, as the browser drew the rows);
300 'Calibri Light' b=0 (the light face
of the minor font is written by name, not as +mj-lt);
400 and 500 +mn-lt b=0 (no static 500 Calibri: the nearest face is Regular); 600 and 700 +mn-lt b=1
(calibrib.ttf is the Bold member); body copy +mn-lt b=0; b and i written both ways.
Counts follow master brief 11 as amended by B:
text 5 = the title (1 paragraph, 2 lines: '...mid-market lending to / private-credit funds' - the browser
breaks at the space before 'private-credit'; with wrap off on a line-locked box (Peter #7) PowerPoint

cannot add a third line, and fit predicts none) + one element per card (each card's

and

s are in-flow
blocks that stack: 2, 2 and 3 paragraphs) + the .weights block (five stacked divs = 1 element of 5
paragraphs, one line each).
shape 3 = the three 0B2545 card roundRects (8 px radius).
Diagnostic: card 2 is clipped by its own overflow:hidden - 1 line and 32 characters hidden ('give the card
the room it needs.'), an error by the contract (text a reader of the design never sees is not exported).
Lint: font-weight 500 and 600 each warn - neither Calibri Light nor Calibri ships a static 500 or 600 face on
this machine (Peter #9: the lint judges the faces installed where the server runs); 300 has calibril.ttf and
700 is exempt. On a machine without Calibri these two warns would be joined by a 300 one.

gateMaxPx2 6,325 = 5,271 px2 masked, measured 2026-09-25 on main 4ab1be8 (fidelity-w2 + X, plan 16 #22) + G-2, references rendered in Calibri / Calibri Light; two runs, identical, + 20 % (Peter #16, plan 11). Of it:

5,113 px2 are the two-line 30 px title - test-16x9's manifest/theme mismatch (G-1 open item 14, D item 17): the browser draws the 700 heading in Calibri Light with synthetic bold, advances unchanged (Edge, measured in weights' notes), while PptxRender, like PowerPoint, draws the file's +mj-lt b=1 through the theme part's major font as Calibri Bold, ~3 % wider and heavier - and 82 px2 card 2's h4, the same cause at 15 px;
76 px2 are card 3's last line, one pixel lower in PptxRender than in the browser (ink rows end at 363 and 364:
the seventh line box of one text frame, line pitch 18.2 px), unarbitrated. The weight rows and the clipped
card are clean at the gate's settings (blur 2, delta E 8, 60 px2 minimum area).

gateMaxPx2 6,326 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 5,271 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.

gateMaxPx2 6,323 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over 5,269 px2 on fidelity/r2-vertical (fidelity r2, 2026-09-25, on main cb68315): the paragraph gap now keeps each card's body under its heading where the browser drew it (text._exact_gap; the 13 px bodies under 15 px headings were 1 px low), -2 px2.
